findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (D) After coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

1) A food handler was observed to don gloves without hand washing. 2) A food handler was observed to drink from a beverage can and not change gloves/ wash hands prior to continuing food service. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to review hand washing procedures and timing with all staff. Ensure that hand washing and glove use is consistently completed in manners that are required by the code.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

On arrival there was not a sanitizer ready for use in the C-store kitchen. The PIC was asked about the situation and prepared a solution during the inspection to correct. Ensure that a sanitizer is available in the food preparation areas at all times that foods re being prepared.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

The ice machine in Caribou Coffee has the scoop used for retrieving the ice observed laying down with the handle in contact with the ice. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-iterate storage practices for this equipment. It is HIGHLY suggested that employees utilize the scoop holder in the equipment that is intended for this purpose moving forward. The scoop was moved to the holder during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

The hand sink by the three part sink in the C-store is without soap at the time of this inspection. The PIC was shown and refilled the dispenser to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sani bucket in the Caribou Coffee shop did not register on the inspector’s test strips. The PIC was shown and had the bucket remade during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all in use sanitizers are maintained at effective concentration at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machines are in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown and instructed to have them cleaned. The nozzles were removed and washed to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned regularly enough to prevent accumulation of filth.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

The gas station side of the permit is without a ready for use sanitizer. Foods are observed being prepared. The PIC and employee were consulted and instructed to have a sanitizer ready for user at all times that foods are being handled/prepared. A bucket was prepared during this inspection to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink in the back area of the C-Store next to the three part sink is observed blocked by a cart. Education was conducted and the cart removed to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

1) Raw eggs are stored over raw bacon in the C-Stores walk in cooler. 2) Raw eggs were also observed stored on top of a container of bread in a reach in cooler. Storage orders were discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to review storage practices with employees. The eggs were moved during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The sani buckets in Caribou did not register on the inspector test strips. The buckets were remade during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machines are in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown and stated that they should be cleaned each night. The nozzles were removed and washed to correct.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. 

Two one gallon containers of milk are observed in the reach in cooler opened and without date markings. PIC and employees were educated and the milk discarded to correct.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Several flies are observed around the drain under the hand sink in Caribou. PIC indicated that they had a compound for cleaning the drains from an issue in the main building and would use that to remove the issue. This may work, if not though pest control should be contacted for help. Follow up to take place in two weeks.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The floor drain under the hand sink in Caribou is missing half of the drain cover. Repair/replace so that solid objects and foods do not fall into the drain.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Kitchen handsink observed without signage reminding employees to wash their hands. Inspector provided sign to be posted.
6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES. [C]

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Items in the hot holding grab & go observed below 135F: fried rice at 117F, pasta dish at 134F, and cheeseburger at 127F, all probed. Ensure all hot held foods are kept at 135F or above. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC. Foods voluntarily discarded.
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Provide a thermometer for the drawer cooler. (Inside an empty pan or another place in the food storage portion of the cooler.)
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: Seal bare wood around the sneeze guard at the hot dog rollers. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training.
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Staff observed to don gloves without washing hands first. Staff must wash hands after any activities that may have contaminated hands before donning gloves or beginning food handling. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC, who will provide education to staff.
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands. [P]

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Boxes in the convenience store storage area observed stored directly on the floor. Discussed proper storage with PIC. Storage will be rearranged so that foods and single service items are at least 6 inches off the floor.
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19  (C) Observed utensils stored on damp cloth in the C-store prep area. Air dry utensils on drainboard or other corrosion-resistant, nonabsorbent and smooth surface.  Reference 4-101.19.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured 0 ppm in sanitizer bucket at Caribou Coffee. Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. Reference 4-501.114. 
CORRECTED- Bucket was remade to correct concentration.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11  (Pf) Food employee dumped liquid foods in the hand sink in the coffee area. Hand washing sink must be used for handwashing only. Reference 5-205.11.
CORRECTED- PIC was informed to only use handsinks for handwashing. Drain coffee in prep sinks. Inspector provided handwashing sign.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Conveinence Store: Observed the creamer machine to have spouts that were not cut at a 45 degree angle with creamer sitting in the spouts. This presents a potential for cross-contamination due to the spout not being refrigerated with the rest of the product. Ensure that the spouts are cut at 45 degree angles to avoid an accumulation of milk in the spout. Employee recut the spouts.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Conveinence Store: Observed a knife in the food prep area of the convinence store that was chipped. Ensure that any food contact surfaces are discarded or repaired if they fall into disrepair. Employee pulled the knife from use. 
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Convenience Store: Observed food being prepared without any sanitiizer made for the dish area or a sanitizer bucket. Ensure that during food prep there is a sanitizer solution made. A sanitizer solution was made by the employee at this time.
750-830 All chemical sanitizers in a dish machine must meet the requirements of 21 CFR 178.1010 to ensure all items are properly sanitized.  Rinse water shall not less than 75F. Provide proper sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Conveinence Store: Observed the coffee spouts and the tea spouts to have an accumulation of calcification and soiled with debris. Ensure these food contact surfaces are washed, rinsed, and sanitized, regularly. 
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Conveinence Store: Observed single-service food sheets in the back prep area of the conveinence store that was soiled with food debris. Ensure that single-service articles are stored in a manner that prevents cross contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Conveinence Store: Observed the coving under the hand sink in the back prep area to be removed from the wall. There was also debris noted behind the three compartment sink by the drain. Ensure that floors and coving are maintained in good repair, as well as smooth and cleanable. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
Conveinence Store: Observed multiple chemical solutions above food products in the dry storage area of the conveinence store. Ensure that toxic items are stored below and away from food products. Employee began rearranging the chemicals immediately.  
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Observed that there is some bracing under the soft drink dispenser in the C store that is constructed of raw 2x4 lumber. This surface should be sealed to protect against moisture absorption. Seal this raw wood surface.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. 
Observed that the drain cup of the floor drain under the espresso machine has some accumulation of solid debris. This is in the Caribou Coffee area. Clean the is drain are to prevent build up.
Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  
Observed that there is some coving along the wall under the hand sink in the store room that has detached from the wall surface. Repair this gap in the wall coving.
Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
Observed that the damp mop was not hung up between uses. Store mop upright between uses to promote air drying.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment: Pizza at the hot holding area is 123F. It is supposed to be wasted every hour but was there for two hours. Five tornados on the roller were at  temperatures of 120F to 126F. 750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above) The Tornados and pizza  were discarded in the garbage .

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: The hot holding case does not have a thermometer. 750.150(a) All hot units that contain potentially hazardous foods shall contain  a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F. Provide thermometer to the hot holding case.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Spouts on the chocolate cappuccino and  sour apple slush machines are soiled. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. Properly wash rinse and sanitize and maintain clean.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: The clean dishes are drying under the area where the hand towel dispenser is located. Wet hands are dripped on clean dishes. If the clean dishes are moved to the other end they will be too close to the wash basin and be exposed to potential contamination. 750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Either relocate the hand towel dispenser or do soiled dishes in the compartment next to the hand sink and dry clean dishes at the other end.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: The single use spoons and stirrers at the coffee shop have dust and crumbs/sugar soil in the bottom of the holders. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user. Clean regularly and maintain free of dust and crumbs.
